key_provisions_or_claims: Safety assessment covers basic capability, actual road performance (mileage, takeover rate, coverage), and accident/emergency handling.
Applicants submit materials to the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area administration; a safety assessment report leads to temporary test plates from traffic police.
Assessment is revoked for false materials, major safety risks, voluntary withdrawal, or no road pilot application within one year.
Applies to road testing and demonstration application across Beijing; effective on issuance.
Defines autonomous vehicles by national standards for conditional, high and full automation.
annotation.summary_en: Beijing municipal trial measures (issued 24 Oct 2025) establishing a safety assessment regime for autonomous vehicles in road testing and demonstration application, covering basic capability, real-road performance and accident handling, with grounds for revocation and key definitions.
